name: Paradip
notes: Channel depth 17.1-18.7m. Coal berths #2/#3: 16.0m draft. Thermal coal berths #5-#8: 14.5m. Inner berths #9-#10: 12.5m. Model by berth type not single port draft. VTMS operated 24/7.

name: Visakhapatnam Outer Harbour
notes: VGCB terminal. Quay length 356m. Super-Capesize capable up to 200000 DWT. Cape-grade coal operations.

name: Visakhapatnam Inner Harbour
notes: EQ-1/VSPL berths: 14.5m draft, 240m LOA. WQ berths: 11.5-14.5m. Two pilots required LOA>195m. Baby-Cape daytime only. NOT same port as outer harbour - model separately.

name: Gangavaram
notes: Standard max draft 17.70m. Case-by-case 18.3m. Channel 21m. All-weather. High mechanisation. 18.2m draft recorded in operations. Adani APSEZ. Adjacent to Vizag. NOTE: NOT in IMF PortWatch layer — operational congestion nowcast proxied via Vizag Outer Anchorage (port1367) + Adani vessel position circulars.

name: Dhamra
notes: Standard 17.20m. Record 2025: 18.40m on 299.95m LOA / 50m beam coking coal vessel. Grab unloaders 2800 tph. Night navigation permitted. Adani APSEZ.

name: Gopalpur
notes: Standard 14.5m. Up to 15.5m possible. 3 multipurpose berths. Mechanised coal import. Adani acquired 95% stake 2024. Hinterland: Odisha/Jharkhand/Chhattisgarh via NH-16. PANAMAX+ NOT full Capesize.

name: Krishnapatnam
notes: 18.5m draft. 5 simultaneous Capesize berths capable. All-weather round-the-clock. Adani Krishnapatnam Port Limited. Contact: akpl.poc@adani.com for vessel vetting.

name: Haldia
notes: Hooghly tidal river. 8.5m max LOA 230m. Siltation and dredging dependent. Draft Forecasts issued regularly at smportkolkata.shipping.gov.in. Water density 1010 brackish - FWA correction mandatory. Coal handling at Berth 3 revived.

name: Sandheads / Sagar Roads
notes: Deepwater anchorage. Capesize/Panamax lighter here via barges for Haldia/Kolkata transit. Effectively unlimited depth. Lightering economics must be modelled for any Haldia cargo: cost = tonnes_lightered * barge_rate + extra_days * (hire + port_consumption).

name: Newcastle (PWCS Kooragang)
notes: SAUCS dynamic UKC system for vessels >=13.6m. LOA>220m requires SAUCS request form. Sailing draft ~16.1m channel depth ~15.2m. NOT fully-laden Capesize port - 180k DWT Cape draws 18m, cannot load full. Air draught 20.5m KCT / 18.5m CCT.

name: Hay Point / DBCT
notes: Design vessel 220000 DWT. Max draft dynamic - tidal windows. Min UKC 1.5m mandatory. Max berthing displacement 110000 MT. Large tidal range up to 7m. Mooring: no nylon lines, MSMP/LMP required from April 2024.

name: Gladstone
notes: Thermal and coking coal. Approx 17-18m draft - UNVERIFIED. Verify against Gladstone Ports Corporation port handbook.

name: Abbot Point
notes: Coking coal. Approx 15.5-16.5m - UNVERIFIED. Verify against NQXT terminal specs.
